description: This file defines the class AOS_QuotesViewDetail, which extends ViewDetail and handles the display logic for quote detail views in the SuiteCRM/AOS_Quotes module. It includes methods to populate quote templates from the database and render HTML templates with Smarty.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to handle the display of quote details and templates within the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to populate quote templates and show HTML popup.

methods.name: populateQuoteTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active quote templates of type 'AOS_Quotes' from the database and populates a global list array.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Prepares and renders HTML using Smarty templates, based on the populated quote templates list.
